reviewer: Claude Opus 5.5 (agent), on the 2025-06-14 0.16 m RGBI orthophoto (castle-n, stadium-ne, stadium-sw), with the reeds the build of main 18cc8148 planted drawn over each water
decision: The owner, 27 November 2026: Bro Hof's mown pond banks bear no reeds. Each water was judged on the photo, never by its kind: a water is named when the photo shows its bank mown to the water's edge, and with a stretch when only part of it is. Mälaren's natural shore, the ponds with a reed belt or unmown banks, and the waters the photo does not reach keep their reeds; so do the mapped beds (silt flats, wetland), wherever they lie.
reader: apps/golf/src/engine/scenery/bro-hof.js mownBanks (the same points and stretches in the pack's local metres: x = E - 649094.5, z = 6598568.5 - N), held equal to this record by bro-hof.test.mjs; the reed scan's rule is ground-cover.mjs onMownBank, ?mownbanks=0 the before.
evidence: Private: brohofbuild/cache/reed-banks/<id>.png, the photo round each water with its outline and the reeds of main 18cc8148 never committed or published.

waters.photo: The island-green pond. Fairway and mown rough to the edge on every side; a stony lip on the west bank, floating weed in the water, no reed fringe.
Mown to the water all round, fairway on the west, green and bunkers on the east; a small rough patch by the green at its south-east, no reeds.
Mown rough in stripes to the edge all round; water lilies in the water, no reed fringe. Mapped as Mälaren by its level, but a closed course pond.
Mown to the water all round, a bunker at its south end; no reeds.

Fairway mown to the water along the south and east banks, the bunker on the east bank among them (the reeds stood in it). The west and north banks and the wooded peninsula carry a real reed fringe: outside the stretch, kept.
A closed pond ringed by cart paths, mown between path and water on every side; no reeds. Mapped as Mälaren by its level.
Mown to the water all round, a stone edge along the north-west bank, a rock island at its west end; no reeds.
The west bank, from the cart path to the water, is mown in stripes: the stretch. A reed fringe lines the north and east banks and wetland scrub the whole south bank: kept.
A narrow pond mown to the edge on both banks; water plants in it, no reed fringe.
Mown on both banks, a tee on the east; lily pads at its south end, no reed fringe.
Fairway and green mown to the water on the east bank, bare rock and mown rough on the west; weed beds stand in the open water, not on the bank, which no bank reed would draw.
Fairway mown to the water along the west and north-west bank: the stretch. A belt of emergent plants lines the east side by the bridge path, the north tip and the south end: kept.
Unmown meadow on the north bank, long rough with young trees and a fringe on the south: no mown bank. Kept.
Mown on the west and on the south down to the bridge: the stretch. Wooded on the north and unmown meadow on the east: kept.
A pool of the creek across Castle 9, mown to the water on both banks.
The creek's pool north of 09-a, mown on both banks.
The creek's pool below the bridge: fairway mown to the east bank; long grass with young trees on the west, and no reed fringe on either.
A pool of the creek by the bridge, mown on both banks.
The creek's pool above the bridge: mown on the west, a boulder bank on the east.
The creek's pool below the bridge, against its boulder bank; mown above it.
Mälaren: a natural shore of reeds, alder and willow round the estate. Kept, with its small parts mapped apart at the shore (659_64-1 to -15, -17, -0-2).
Mälaren's inlet below Stadium 13 and 14: a wooded reed shore. Kept.
Mälaren's shore below the houses west of the castle: wooded, reeds. Kept, as are -10, -14 and -17 beside it.
